text: Georg, Anna, their son Georgie and their dog arrive at their lakefront holiday home in Austria. A polite young man named Peter [comes to the kitchen to borrow eggs|rules|it must be let in], and soon he and his friend Paul are holding the family hostage. Through one long night the pair [play sadistic games|images|gatherings, games and closeness] with their captives and bet that none of them will live until morning. When the family finally strikes back, Paul [rewinds the film itself|rules|reality comes apart], and by morning he is [knocking on another neighbour's door|ending|the evil is handed on], asking for eggs.
